title: Squash Analyzer
shortDescription: Keep track of squash matches as a coach or referee and earn badges.
fullDescription:
Squash Analyzer helps coaches and referees keep track of squash matches, point by point.

REFEREE
• Tap the score to award a rally
• LET, STROKE and undo, also after resuming a match
• Service side left/right and a timeline with every rally
• Match and game timers, and after every game the result with duration and rallies
• Matches are saved automatically and can be resumed
• Best of 1, 3 or 5, and edit the names during the match

COACH
• Record for every point who scored, how (winner, pressure, error or service point), from which zone and with which shot
• For an unforced error also the kind: down, out, service or floor
• START GAME at the first service, so the warm-up does not count
• Court in 6 or 9 zones, and a switch for volleys
• Analysis per game: heatmap, shots, point breakdown and tactical advice
• Optional: AI Coach with your own OpenAI key

PLAYERS AND BADGES
• Save your players with a photo and focus points; import a whole team with one link
• Players earn 37 badges, such as 5 points in a row or a game won 11-0; seventeen of them in bronze, silver and gold
• Share a player's badge card as a picture with a link; it opens in the app (Android and iPhone) or in the browser

MY TEAM
• Playing in the Dutch SBN league via sbn.toernooi.nl? See your team's standings and schedule on the home screen

LIVE SHARING
• Share a link and let your team follow the score live in the browser, with player photos (can be turned off)

SHARING AND BACKUP
• Share the score as a scorecard, report or picture, for example in WhatsApp
• Back up to a folder of your choice, also automatically

PRIVACY
• No account needed
• Everything stays on your device; only with live sharing do first names, the score and (if you leave it on) small player photos go to our server temporarily
• No ads, no tracking

Manual: https://squashanalyzer.com/en/guide/android.html
